name: Layout Builder Claro
description: Attemps to match Layout Builder styles with Claro admin theme.
project_description:
An opinionated attempt at making the transition between the Claro admin theme and a custom themes Layout Builder pages smoother.

 Includes a nice wide Off Canvas tray and themed Media Library.

 Back to top 

 Requires 
 
 Layout Builder 
 Claro 
 Media Library 
 
 Back to top 

 Drupal 10 
 Drupal 10 compatibility is built on the 2.x branch. Please test and report any bugs!

 Note there is a Drupal core issue with Layout builder's off canvas styling with CKEditor 5 [#3341737]
